event.event_name: 2015-2016 El Nino drought in western Pacific island capitals

formula_definitions.window_days: inclusive days from event start through event end

event_window.end_date_basis: NOAA report publication date for the 'since January' rainfall statement

threshold_result.interpretation: Observed rain was 27% of normal for 111 days with a 559 mm deficit, meeting every persistence and severity test.

criteria.name: answer_schema_and_units
criteria.description: Returns the requested six-field JSON, keeps millimeters and millimeters per day distinct, and includes a numeric interpretation sentence.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points if the JSON is mostly complete but one nested block or unit label is missing; award 1 point if the classification is present but the ledger shape is not usable.

criteria.name: rainfall_ledger
criteria.description: Extracts 8 inches observed, 22 inches below average, computes 30 inches inferred normal, and converts to 203.2 mm, 558.8 mm, and 762.0 mm.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 3-4 points for correct inch values with one conversion or inferred-normal error; award 1-2 points for using the right quantities but leaving them in inches or mixing observed and deficit depths.

criteria.name: duration_and_rates
criteria.description: Computes the inclusive 111-day report-effective window and daily rates near 1.83, 5.03, and 6.86 mm/day.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points if the day count is correct but one rate is rounded or copied incorrectly; award 1 point if the rates are computed with a one-day endpoint error.

criteria.name: normalized_indices
criteria.description: Computes observed_fraction near 0.267, deficit_index near 0.733, and stress_score near 0.733 using capped duration and record-span factors.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points if two of the three indices are correct; award 1 point if the ratios use the right numerator values but the wrong denominator or omit one cap.

criteria.name: threshold_proof_and_classification
criteria.description: Evaluates all four threshold tests correctly and returns the extreme persistent rainfall-deficit water-supply drought label.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points if the final label is correct but one Boolean test is missing; award 1 point if the tests are listed but one inequality direction is reversed.

criteria.name: bounded_interpretation
criteria.description: Rejects the short-shower interpretation from the calculation and avoids loss, field-guidance, or broad attribution statements.
criteria.partial_credit: Award the point for a concise interpretation tied to the ledger; withhold it for broad attribution or loss statements that are not computed here.

provenance.notes: Values are extracted from local CSX-159 records; no network access is used.
